english: A frameless poster that shows any image from the internet. Place it, press E, paste an image link (PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB) and the poster loads it. The image fills the board; add the word fit or stretch after the link to change that. Clear the text to get a blank board back. Identical 1x1 posters with the same link tile into one big image.

Spray art straight on the wall: shows an image from a link with its transparency kept, no board behind it. Place it on a wall, press E, paste a link to a transparent PNG. The faint ghost panel disappears once the image loads. Identical graffiti blocks with the same link tile into one big piece.
